operations.title: List my workspaces
operations.description: Start here. Lists the DesKilo workspaces this person may use through this assistant, each with its workspace_id, name and the operations allowed there. Every other tool needs one of these workspace_id values; when the person has several workspaces, ask which one unless the request makes it obvious.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 25).

operations.title: What can I do here?
operations.description: What this assistant may do in one workspace right now and until when access is approved, plus the workspace's time zone, currency, opening hours and its named booking periods (morning, afternoon, full_day) with their exact local times. Call it before booking to read "tomorrow morning" in the workspace's zone, and when a tool is missing or a call was refused, to explain what is allowed.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

operations.title: Find free places
operations.description: Which seats can be booked for a time window in a workspace, each with a label naming its level, office, desk and seat (e.g. "Level 2 · Open space · Desk 4 · Seat B") and its level_id/office_id, so a follow-up can filter by level_id or office_id. "free" is the booking engine's own verdict for this person (opening hours, booking granularity, limits, blocks and existing bookings), so a free seat_id can be passed to deskilo_create_reservation. Paged: pass next_cursor to see more.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

starts_at.description: Start of the time you want to book, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset in the workspace's time zone, e.g. 2026-10-05T09:00:00+02:00.

ends_at.description: End of the time you want to book, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset; at most 31 days after starts_at.

level_id.description: Optional: only places on this level (a level_id from an earlier answer).

office_id.description: Optional: only places in this office (an office_id from an earlier answer).

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the next one. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 25).

operations.title: List my bookings
operations.description: The person's own bookings that overlap a window (at most 31 days), oldest first, with reservation_id, a label naming the place, times, status and state_digest. Use it before moving, checking in, checking out or cancelling a booking.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

from.description: Window start, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. The window is at most 31 days.

to.description: Window end, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset, after from.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 25).

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the next one. Omit for the first page.

operations.title: Describe a place
operations.description: Describe one place: a seat, a desk, an office or a level (by its id from deskilo_get_availability or deskilo_list_my_reservations), or one of the person's own reservations by reservation_id. Answers what it is, where it sits (level, office, desk), how many seats it has and what a seat offers. It never includes a picture by default: set include_image to true ONLY when the person explicitly asks to see an image, picture, plan or map; the answer then carries a floor-plan picture with that place highlighted. It also carries the person's favourite mark and the place's rating.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

reservation_id.description: One of the person's own reservations (a reservation_id from deskilo_list_my_reservations): describes the place it is for.

include_image.description: False by default. True ONLY when the person explicitly asked for an image, picture, plan or map of the place: the answer then carries a floor-plan picture with the place highlighted. Never set it on your own initiative.

operations.title: My favourite places
operations.description: The places this person marked as favourites in one workspace (seats, desks, offices, levels), each with its label, its kind, its id and its rating (average, how many rated, and the person's own). To book one, pass its id to deskilo_create_reservation (seat_id, desk_id, office_id or level_id by kind) with the usual date and period or times.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

operations.title: My monthly statement
operations.description: The person's own statement for one month: subscription fee, included and used half-days, overage, supplements, credits, balance and VAT. Amounts are integer minor units (cents) of `currency`.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

operations.title: List my invoices
operations.description: The person's own invoices, newest first: number, period, kind, total in minor units (cents) with its currency, issue time and whether it was voided. Paged.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

limit.description: How many items to return (1-100, default 25).

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the next one. Omit for the first page.

operations.title: Book a place
operations.description: Book a place for the person: a seat (usually a seat_id from deskilo_get_availability), or a whole desk, office or level where the workspace allows it. The workspace's own rules apply exactly as in the app; a refusal says why in plain words. Generate a new request_id per booking; resending the same request_id never books twice. To book "the full day", "the morning" or "the afternoon" give date and period instead of times: the workspace's own booking periods (see deskilo_get_capabilities, booking_periods) are applied exactly.

request_id.description: A new random UUID for each distinct intent. Reuse the SAME request_id, with the same arguments, only to retry that intent (after a timeout, or after the person confirmed it in the DesKilo app): it never acts twice.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

seat_id.description: The seat to book: a seat_id from deskilo_get_availability with free = true.

desk_id.description: Book a whole desk instead of one seat (only where the workspace books desks as a whole).

office_id.description: Book a whole office instead of one seat (only where the workspace books offices as a whole).

level_id.description: Book a whole level instead of one seat (only where the workspace books levels as a whole).

starts_at.description: Start, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset in the workspace's time zone, e.g. 2026-10-05T09:00:00+02:00. Optional when date and period are given.

ends_at.description: End, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset, after starts_at. Optional when date and period are given.

date.description: The local day to book, YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace's time zone. Use with period instead of starts_at/ends_at.

period.description: A booking period of the workspace, named in get_capabilities (booking_periods) with its exact local times: morning, afternoon or the full working day. Use with date; the server turns it into the workspace's exact times, so never compute them yourself.

check_in.description: True to check the person in at once (only when the booking starts now). Default false.

operations.title: Move my booking
operations.description: Change the start and end of one of the person's own bookings. The workspace's rules apply as in the app. To book "the full day", "the morning" or "the afternoon" give date and period instead of times: the workspace's own booking periods (see deskilo_get_capabilities, booking_periods) are applied exactly.

request_id.description: A new random UUID for each distinct intent. Reuse the SAME request_id, with the same arguments, only to retry that intent (after a timeout, or after the person confirmed it in the DesKilo app): it never acts twice.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a workspace_id from deskilo_list_workspaces. Never guess it.

starts_at.description: The new start, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. Optional when date and period are given.

ends_at.description: The new end, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset. Optional when date and period are given.

date.description: The local day to book, YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace's time zone. Use with period instead of starts_at/ends_at.

period.description: A booking period of the workspace, named in get_capabilities (booking_periods) with its exact local times: morning, afternoon or the full working day. Use with date; the server turns it into the workspace's exact times, so never compute them yourself.

expected_state.description: Optional: the state_digest you last read for this reservation. If it changed since, nothing happens and the answer is a conflict carrying the current state.

native_rpcs.purpose: The one facade every tools/call reaches; it re-checks the caller, the policy and the confirmation.
What tools/list answers: the operations this caller may call now.
Accept or decline one exact action, in the Deskilo app only.
Read one pending confirmation.
The owner reads what the workspace exposes.
The owner saves the exposure and the optional display fields it allows, within the database maximum (#1645); a stale revision is refused.
The caller's own database eligibility and administrator status.
Ask a database administrator for assistant eligibility.
Withdraw one's own request or eligibility.
A database administrator's review queue.
Approve or reject a request, with a second factor.
Revoke an eligibility, with a second factor.
What an assistant connection may be granted; with the pending authorization, the client's approval status, its redirect host and who decides the first open step.
A database administrator reads the installation maximum of optional display fields (#1809).
A database administrator saves that maximum; it never widens a policy or a consent (#1809).
The caller's own identity binding on this installation (#1647).
Bind the caller's verified identity to this installation's account (#1647).
Remove the caller's own identity binding (#1647).
Record the workspaces and operations a pending assistant authorization may receive (#1615).
Finalise the connection after Auth approved the authorization (#1615).
The assistants the caller connected, with their workspaces (#1628).
Remove one workspace from one assistant connection (#1628).
Disconnect one assistant from every workspace on this installation (#1628).
The caller's own assistant usage today, counts only (#1630).
A workspace's assistant usage over 30 days, for its owner or a database administrator (#1630).
